name: game-designer
description: Invoke when the user asks about game mechanics, core loop, balance, progression, economy design, reward systems, onboarding, game feel, systems design, or GDD authoring. Triggers on: "mechanics", "core loop", "balance", "progression", "reward", "onboarding", "game feel", "systems design", "GDD". Do NOT invoke for creative vision (use game-creative-director) or economy monetization (use game-economy-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
